purpose: Diagnose V3 precision failure without retraining by correcting preregistered crop-boundary scoring and recording exact remaining unmatched decoded events.

scoring.boundaryRule: derive whole-event intervals from prepared carryIn/carryOut eventId occupancy and pass those preregistered intervals to event_contract_v2.score_events on both prediction and reference sides
scoring.detailedOutput: record boundary-excluded predictions plus every remaining false-positive event with decoder probabilities, target onset/state, and nearest reference timing

decisionBoundary: Diagnostic output is evidence only. It cannot authorize retraining, threshold changes, P2/P3, cross-performer screening or full training.
